description: Mash automatic memory: recall project records and recent chats at session start and file reads, and tell the agent how to save memory as it happens by citing its own session. A prompt stating a lasting preference or decision gets a save reminder. An occasional Stop check, never in a session's first fifteen minutes and at most once every fifteen minutes, asks for anything missed. Historical backfill runs separately during explicit setup or maintenance. Fails open; opt-out is MASH_RECORD_CAPTURE=off.
